fullData.title: Adding on a Number Line Without Regrouping
fullData.subject: Arithmetic

problem.statement: Leo is using a number line to add two numbers without regrouping. He starts at $24$ and jumps forward by $13$ in two steps: first he jumps forward by $10$ to reach $34$, and then he jumps forward by $3$ more. Use the number line to find his final destination.

fullData.solutionStrategy: Count forward along the number line first by tens and then by ones to find the sum.

annotations.steps: Leo makes a first jump of ten forward from twenty-four on the number line.
annotations.strategy: I notice that adding the tens first makes the big leap easier to track.
annotations.misconceptions: Students might mistakenly jump by ones instead of tens, slowing down the addition process.
annotations.connections: This connects base-ten place value to visual movement along a number line.
annotations.narrative: On the number line in Figure 1, the first jump of $+10$ moves Leo from the Start point at $24$ to the tick marked $34$.

challenge.prompt: Leo is at 34 and counts forward 3 ones on the number line. What number does he land on?
challenge.rationale: Counting forward 3 units from 34 lands on 37, while 36 is a common mistake from counting the starting number 34 as the first jump.

annotations.steps: Count forward 3 ticks from 34 on the number line to reach 37.
annotations.strategy: I notice that adding the remaining ones finishes our total jump.
annotations.misconceptions: Forgetting to count the starting tick or miscounting the hops.
annotations.connections: This connects counting on with addition on a number line.
annotations.narrative: From tick $34$, count forward $3$ ticks to reach the End point at $37$, which means Leo's final destination is $34 + 3 = 37$.

specs.title: Jump forward by tens
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Decompose the two-digit addition by making the larger leap of tens first along the number line.
specs.seedNotes: Represent the jump of +10 from the starting point 24 to reach 34 as 24 + 10 = 34.

specs.title: Jump forward by ones
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Complete the addition by counting on the remaining ones to reach the final sum.
specs.seedNotes: Represent counting forward 3 units from 34 to reach the end point 37 via 34 + 3 = 37.
